knowledge:
- key_parameters: input=A directory path containing contig files or a list/data frame of pre-loaded contig data in loadContigs() ;; format=A string specifying the data format (e.g., "10X", "TRUST4", "WAT3R", "auto") in loadContigs() ;; removeNA=If TRUE, removes any cell barcode with an NA value in at least one chain in combineTCR() ;; removeMulti=If TRUE, removes any cell barcode with more than two immune receptor chains in combineTCR() ;; filterMulti=If TRUE, isolates the top two expressed chains in cell barcodes with multiple chains in combineTCR() or combineBCR() ;; call.related.clones=If TRUE, uses clonalCluster() to group B cells into clones based on CDR3 sequence similarity in combineBCR() ;; threshold=The similarity threshold (normalized Levenshtein distance, default 0.85) for clonalCluster() or combineBCR() ;; cloneCall=Defines how clones are called ("gene", "nt", "aa", "strict") in visualization functions ;; scale=If TRUE, scales outputs to relative percentages/proportions/densities instead of raw counts ;; group.by=Column header in metadata to group clonal frequency/proportion calculations in combineExpression() ;; proportion=If TRUE, calculates the proportion of the clone; if FALSE, calculates total frequency in combineExpression()
- alternatives: immunarch=An alternative format for exporting clonal data via exportClones(format = "immunarch") ;; iNEXT=Used internally by clonalRarefaction() for rarefaction/extrapolation curves ;; powerTCR=Mentioned for discrete gamma-GPD spliced threshold modeling of clonal size distribution ;; ProjectTIL=Mentioned as the inspiration for the clonalOverlay() visualization
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing single-cell VDJ sequencing data (TCR or BCR) alone or in combination with single-cell RNA-seq data (Seurat or SingleCellExperiment) to track clonal expansion, diversity, gene usage, and transcriptomic phenotypes of specific clones.
- pitfalls: Barcode mismatch=createHTOContigList() and combineExpression() depend heavily on exact barcode matches between single-cell objects and contigs; prefixes or suffixes added during integration/processing will cause failure ;; Duplicate barcodes in TCR + BCR=If a cell has both Ig and TCR information, combineExpression() will not add immune receptor information for those cells if there are duplicate barcodes ;; VDJ gene bias in clustering=VDJ genes are highly variable and can skew UMAP/tSNE projections and clustering based on clonal expansion rather than cell state; use quietVDJgenes(), quietTCRgenes(), or quietBCRgenes() to remove them before dimensional reduction ;; Seurat 5.3.1 bug=DimPlot no longer handles NA values for cloneSize or highlight groupings, which may require updates or workarounds

workflows.name: tcr_repertoire_analysis
workflows.intent: Process raw TCR contig data, combine them into clones, and perform basic and advanced repertoire visualizations and diversity analyses without single-cell expression data.
input: filtered_contig_annotations.csv (10x Genomics Cell Ranger VDJ output or other supported formats like TRUST4, WAT3R)
workflows.stages: 1. Load contigs using loadContigs() or manual list creation. 2. Combine contigs into TCR clones using combineTCR(). 3. Add metadata variables using addVariable(). 4. Quantify and visualize clones using clonalQuant(), clonalAbundance(), clonalLength(), clonalCompare(), and clonalScatter(). 5. Analyze clonal dynamics using clonalHomeostasis() and clonalProportion(). 6. Summarize gene usage and properties using percentGenes(), percentVJ(), percentAA(), positionalEntropy(), positionalProperty(), and percentKmer(). 7. Compare diversity and overlap using clonalDiversity(), clonalRarefaction(), clonalSizeDistribution(), and clonalOverlap().
workflows.code:
data("contig_list")
combined.TCR <- combineTCR(contig_list, 
                           samples = c("P17B", "P17L", "P18B", "P18L", 
                                            "P19B","P19L", "P20B", "P20L"),
                           removeNA = FALSE, 
                           removeMulti = FALSE, 
                           filterMulti = FALSE)
combined.TCR <- addVariable(combined.TCR, 
                            variable.name = "Type", 
                            variables = rep(c("B", "L"), 4))
clonalQuant(combined.TCR, 
            cloneCall="strict", 
            chain = "both", 
            scale = TRUE)
clonalAbundance(combined.TCR, 
                cloneCall = "gene", 
                scale = FALSE)
clonalLength(combined.TCR, 
             cloneCall="aa", 
             chain = "both") 
clonalCompare(combined.TCR, 
                  top.clones = 10, 
                  samples = c("P17B", "P17L"), 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  graph = "alluvial")
clonalScatter(combined.TCR, 
              cloneCall ="gene", 
              x.axis = "P18B", 
              y.axis = "P18L",
              dot.size = "total",
              graph = "proportion")
clonalHomeostasis(combined.TCR, 
                  cloneCall = "gene")
clonalProportion(combined.TCR, 
                 cloneCall = "gene") 
percentGenes(combined.TCR,
             chain = "TRB",
             gene = "Vgene",
             summary.fun = "percent")
percentAA(combined.TCR, 
          chain = "TRB", 
          aa.length = 20)
positionalEntropy(combined.TCR, 
                  chain = "TRB", 
                  aa.length = 20)
clonalDiversity(combined.TCR, 
                cloneCall = "gene")
clonalOverlap(combined.TCR, 
              cloneCall = "strict", 
              method = "morisita")

workflows.name: bcr_repertoire_clustering
workflows.intent: Process raw BCR contig data, group related clones using sequence similarity or alignment metrics, and analyze B cell clonal relationships.
workflows.stages: 1. Combine BCR contigs and cluster related clones using combineBCR(). 2. Perform advanced alignment-based clustering using Needleman-Wunsch (dist_type = "nw") and substitution matrices. 3. Filter non-productive and multi-chain contigs.
workflows.code:
BCR.contigs <- read.csv("https://www.borch.dev/uploads/contigs/b_contigs.csv")
combined.BCR.clustered <- combineBCR(BCR.contigs, 
                                     samples = "Patient1", 
                                     threshold = 0.85)
combined.BCR.aligned <- combineBCR(BCR.contigs, 
                                   samples = "Patient1",
                                   sequence = "aa",        
                                   dist_type = "nw",      
                                   dist_mat = "BLOSUM80",  
                                   threshold = 0.85)
cleaned.BCR <- combineBCR(BCR.contigs,
                          samples = "Patient1",
                          filterNonproductive = TRUE,
                          filterMulti = TRUE)

workflows.name: integrated_single_cell_analysis
workflows.intent: Integrate processed TCR/BCR clonal data with single-cell RNA-seq objects (Seurat or SingleCellExperiment) to analyze clonal phenotypes and spatial distribution on dimensional reductions.
input: combined.TCR (processed TCR clone list from combineTCR)
workflows.stages: 1. Exclude VDJ genes from highly variable features using quietTCRgenes(), quietBCRgenes(), or quietVDJgenes(). 2. Merge clonal data into the single-cell object using combineExpression(). 3. Visualize clonal expansion on UMAP/tSNE using clonalOverlay(). 4. Map clonal sharing between clusters using clonalNetwork(). 5. Highlight specific clones using highlightClones(). 6. Analyze cluster occupancy using clonalOccupy(). 7. Track clones across categorical variables using alluvialClones(). 8. Generate chord diagrams of clonal sharing using vizCirclize() or getCirclize(). 9. Calculate STARTRAC diversity indices using StartracDiversity(). 10. Calculate clonal bias using clonalBias().
workflows.code:
scRep_example <- get(data("scRep_example"))
sce <- Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment(scRep_example)
scRep_example$Patient <- substr(scRep_example$orig.ident, 1,3)
scRep_example$Type <- substr(scRep_example$orig.ident, 4,4)
scRep_example <- quietTCRgenes(scRep_example)
sce <- combineExpression(combined.TCR, 
                         sce, 
                         cloneCall="gene", 
                         group.by = "sample", 
                         proportion = TRUE)
scRep_example <- combineExpression(combined.TCR, 
                                   scRep_example, 
                                   cloneCall="gene", 
                                   group.by = "sample", 
                                   proportion = FALSE, 
                                   cloneSize=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))
clonalOverlay(scRep_example, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              cutpoint = 1, 
              bins = 10, 
              facet.by = "Patient") + 
              guides(color = "none")
library(ggraph)
clonalNetwork(scRep_example, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              group.by = "seurat_clusters",
              filter.clones = NULL,
              filter.identity = NULL,
              cloneCall = "aa")
clonalOccupy(scRep_example, 
              x.axis = "seurat_clusters")
alluvialClones(scRep_example,
               clone.call = "aa",
               y.axes = c("Patient", "ident", "Type"),
               color = c("CVVSDNTGGFKTIF_CASSVRRERANTGELFF", "NA_CASSVRRERANTGELFF"))
library(circlize)
library(scales)
vizCirclize(scRep_example,
            group.by = "seurat_clusters",
            clone.call = "aa")
StartracDiversity(scRep_example, 
                  type = "Type", 
                  group.by = "Patient")
clonalBias(scRep_example, 
           cloneCall = "aa", 
           split.by = "Patient", 
           group.by = "seurat_clusters",
           n.boots = 10, 
           min.expand =5)
